source.author: Kenney
source.note: Wave-1 row 191 named a Quaternius static model on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits). Kenney Food Kit (same pinned zip as cake and onigiri) has no noodle, ramen or udon member; its bowls are `bowl` (empty), `bowl-cereal` (orange cereal, spoon), `bowl-broth` (purple band, egg halves, a fried-tofu slab, a green garnish) and `bowl-soup` (white hexagonal bowl, pale broth, scallion flecks and three thick loops standing out of the broth). `bowl-soup` is used: its loops read as thick udon noodles once coloured white. Two copies of the kit `chopstick.glb` are added with boneless `ingest.attach` (scale 1.4, laid side by side across the back of the rim) so the bowl reads as noodles even from the side. Unlike the `ramen` entry (red bowl, dark-orange broth, egg, chashu, upright wooden chopsticks): a white bowl with a brown band, pale dashi broth, white noodle loops, brown scallion flecks and red lacquer chopsticks lying flat. Colours (noon): bowl and inner wall practical with a moon shade; band iris; broth sky with skin shade; noodle loops (their colour cluster also covers the thin broth ring at the wall, which reads as bowl) practical with moon shade; scallions iris (noon has no green); chopsticks accent with iris shade, threshold -0.5. Size: normalised by total height; the bowl across the flats (x) is the 0.18-0.2 m dimension. Round-ish, no facing. Static, no clips.
